name: comp-121
title: Social Login Labeled Buttons
blurb: Full-width social login buttons with icons and text labels, stacked vertically.
description: Four stacked outline buttons for social login, each with a brand-colored icon and text label. Arranged with flex-col and gap.
use_when: Offering prominent social authentication with clear labels.
avoid_when: When horizontal space is limited or when you prefer icon-only buttons.
a11y: Icons are aria-hidden. Text labels clearly identify each provider.
